title.en: An Act Changing the Name of a Barrio in the Municipality of Rizal, Province of Nueva Ecija, From "Delinquente" to "Coronel Paco Roman.

text.en:
The name of the barrio of "Delinquente," in the municipality of Rizal, Province of Nueva Ecija,
to all intents and purposes, shall hereafter be known as "Coronel Paco Roman."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 29, 1933.
